D.t: Kelly Morrison leads by 36.0 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 125,862 votes; a one point swing is about 1,748 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +28.7 and D +42.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
